coverage.rationale: The window covers contemporary probabilistic MPC, human-motion prediction and mobile-robot NMPC; older foundational work is recovered by logged backward snowballing without altering database flow counts.

screening.conflict_resolution: All changed decisions are logged; unresolved scientific eligibility is escalated to the principal-investigator review before synthesis.

export_tool.name: Crossref REST API relevance-ranked JSON export

databases.access_note: Public REST endpoint is accessible and used as a non-exhaustive, relevance-ranked recall supplement capped at 1000 records per query.

retrieval_policy.scope_statement: Top 1000 relevance-ranked Crossref records per frozen query; this recall-supplement source is explicitly non-exhaustive.

export_tool.name: Semantic Scholar paper bulk search JSON export

databases.access_note: The public bulk-search endpoint supports title/abstract Boolean matching, date and publication-type filters, and token pagination.

retrieval_policy.scope_statement: Retrieve every record exposed by Semantic Scholar token pagination; the reported total is descriptive and is not forced to equal the retrieved count.

snowballing.stopping_rule: Stop only after two consecutive backward and forward rounds add no new nearest-work mechanism, baseline or gap-changing evidence.

preexecution_amendment.reason: Version 2 already recorded the Scopus and Web of Science access amendment. Before any official query execution, version 3 freezes database-specific retrieval semantics: all-result export for IEEE Xplore, token exhaustion and an explicit screening-metadata projection for Semantic Scholar, and an explicitly non-exhaustive top-1000 relevance cap for the Crossref recall supplement.
